notes: Full-bleed board square textures. Pair dark+light from the same set when tiling an 8x8 board. Paths are relative to this catalogue file.

dark.read: Deep black-brown polished hardwood with strong vertical grain; dense, almost charcoal in the shadows, warm brown highlights in the figure. Reads as a traditional dark chess square.

light.read: Cream off-white bone ivory with soft natural growth lines and gentle mottling. Warm, not pure white; pairs with ebony for high classic contrast.

dark.read: Rich reddish-brown polished mahogany, lively open grain and ribbon figure. Warmer and lighter than ebony; board contrast is softer and more inviting.

light.read: Pale blonde ash timber with fine straight grain. Very light cream-tan, almost blond maple; clean bright square against mahogany.

dark.read: Dark gunmetal brushed steel, soft anisotropic horizontal scratch grain, cool neutral gray-black. Matte-satin metal, no sharp specular hotspots.

light.read: Pale silver brushed aluminum with matching horizontal brush texture. Cool light gray, pairs with the gunmetal tile as a monochrome metal board.

dark.material: matte black tech panel with neon circuits
dark.read: Matte black carbon-tech plate overlaid with glowing magenta and electric cyan circuit traces and a faint micro-grid. Strong neon punch; the dark square of a Sprawl-side board.

light.material: frosted pale tech acrylic with iridescent filigree
light.read: Frosted pale gray-white tech acrylic with soft pink and cyan circuit filigree and a light holographic sheen. Brighter, gentler twin to the dark cyberpunk panel.

dark.read: Plain flat dark square with no texture or grain.

light.read: Plain flat light square with no texture or grain.
